context_notes: Chapter 3 explicitly assumes C² regularity. The condition-number interpretation uses 0<α≤β and κ=β/α.

The owned APIs generalize Euclidean space to complete real Hilbert spaces, and retain signed-modulus or α=0 intermediate extensions. Those are disclosed API generalizations, not changes to the source exercise.
The answer minimizes a uniform curvature-endpoint bound, not the actual optimal Lipschitz constant of each objective.
unformalized_context: The source's informal large-condition-number iteration-complexity comparison is contextual commentary, not an output of the two named owned declarations.

The finite-dimensional eigenvalue presentation and κ notation are explained in the mathematical answer; the actual owned proofs use the symmetric Rayleigh norm formula and the equivalent (β−α)/(α+β) expression. No separate eigenvalue-list or asymptotic-complexity declaration is claimed.
